about.title: About Black Girl's Dream Initiative
about.lead: A youth-led not-for-profit in Ibadan, founded by Karimot Odebode, working for quality education and for girls' place in leadership.
about.mission: To build an equitable society by empowering women and girls to be leaders and decision-makers, and reorienting boys and men.
about.vision: To be a foremost organisation that transforms education and bridges the gender gap.
about.story1: Karimot Odebode founded Black Girl's Dream Initiative in Ibadan in 2021, starting with debate and public speaking sessions for girls in public secondary schools.
about.story2: BGDI is youth-led: most of the people who run it, and every coach, are young volunteers. Its programmes now cover debate, STEM, getting out-of-school children back into class, and tracking how education money is spent.

best.d: We aim for the best outcome for every student, not the easiest one.

accountability.d: We publish what we do and measure whether it works.

leadership.d: Every girl can lead. We give her the room and the practice.

collaboration.d: We work with schools, families, government and partners.

kindness.d: We treat every child, volunteer and family with care.

about.howLead: Art, advocacy, research, technology and sport, used as tools for development. Our figures so far:
about.closeTitle: Help the next girl find her voice

coach.title: Speech coach
coach.allDone: You've passed every lesson. Keep sharp with free practice.
coach.historyEmpty: No speeches yet. Your first one takes two minutes.

blocked.title: Practice isn't open for you yet
blocked.disabled: Speech practice is paused for everyone at the moment. Please check back soon.
blocked.not_student: Speech practice is for BGDI students.
blocked.not_ready: Practice opens once your sign-up is complete and your guardian has given permission.
blocked.no_consent: Your parent or guardian needs to allow AI speech practice first. They can turn it on in their own Hub: they sign in with their phone number and tick “AI speech practice” under your name.

rec.tip2: Give a reason and an example.

error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.

wait.title: Listening to your speech…
wait.lead: This usually takes under a minute. You can leave this page; your scorecard will be here when it's ready.

card.notYet: Not quite yet: try once more
card.betterTitle: A stronger way to say it
card.numbers: {wpm} words a minute · {fillers} filler words · {seconds} seconds

rejected.title: We couldn't score that one
rejected.too_short: That was a bit short. Speak for longer so your coach has enough to hear.
rejected.too_few_words: We heard only a few words. Try speaking a little louder and closer to the phone.
rejected.unclear: We couldn't hear you clearly. Try somewhere quieter.
rejected.server: Something went wrong on our side. This one doesn't count toward your limit: please try again.
rejected.note: This speech doesn't count toward your monthly limit.
